description: This file defines the FormBuilder class within the Goteo\Util\Form namespace. It sets up form handling with Symfony components, including form factory creation, view rendering engine, CSRF protection, validation, and translation resource registration. The class provides methods to create form builders, access the rendering engine, and retrieve the form view.

classes.name: FormBuilder
classes.description: A class responsible for setting up and providing access to a Symfony-based form factory, rendering engine, and form creation utilities, including support for CSRF, validation, and translations within the Goteo application.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the FormBuilder by setting up CSRF protection, translation resources, view engine, validator, and form factory with necessary extensions.

methods.name: createBuilder
methods.description: Creates and returns a new form builder instance with default data, name, and options.

methods.name: getFactory
methods.description: Returns the form factory instance, initializing it if necessary.

methods.name: getEngine
methods.description: Provides access to the form rendering engine.

methods.name: getForm
methods.description: Retrieves the default form view for rendering.
